A double-acting reciprocating pump running at 40 rpm is discharging 1.0 $1 1 7 ^ { 3 }$ 15 of water   
<sub>per</sub> minute. The pump has a stroke of 400 mm. The diameter of the piston is 200 mm.

and power required to drive the pump.
